# "Harder to detect when sneaking" Armor doesn't stack (HTD / Harder to detect)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_52_nukaknights-post-htd-stackt-nicht.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

We always get the question in the Nuke Knights group as to whether you need **more than 1 piece of armor with HTD (Harder to Detect), in German "harder to detect when sneaking"**.

## The answer is: no.

The legendary perk does not stack. However, you can still increase your stealth skills with perk cards, cleaners, darkened mods, etc.

Equipping more than 1 piece of armor with this legendary 3rd perk does not make you any better hidden.

## Why isn't HTD stacking?

This can be tested by crouching, e.g. approach the turrets and pay attention to the upper "hidden" brackets. The further apart the brackets are, the more likely you are to be discovered. If you are better hidden, the brackets will move further inwards. In this case, the position of the brackets does not change if you equip more than 1 HTD armor piece.

## Additionally improve sneaking ability

However, what improves the **"Sneak" ability** in addition to an armor piece with HTD are the following points:

- High agility: The higher the better. “Unyielding” builds have a clear advantage here in terms of the build concept and have good stealth abilities even without additional perks
- Armor - Mod: Supple on the feet
- Armor Mod: Ultralight construction
- Armor Mod: Darkened
- Lighter armor
- Covert use scout armor
- Chameleon armor (where the advantage of Unyielding and high agility outweighs normal)
- Perk card (Agility): Escape (lets you sneak silently and creates a brief camouflage field when you duck, which quickly "hides" you again).
- Perk card (Agility): Sneak at level 1,2 or 3
- No power armor (too heavy and too loud, even with chameleon part)
- Cleaner (4th hidden perk "Improved stealth. Faster stealth speed")
- 3rd legendary perk: Creates a cloaking field
- Aid: Stealthboy
- Sneak bobblehead
- Magazines that improve stealth or agility

In this video, Angry Turtle explains and tests this problem in great detail:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NxedDIg9q4g
